content:
Day One Arrival in Tokyo  
Thou dost arrive at Narita Airport  
Take the train to thy lodging in Shinjuku  
Stroll the neon lit streets of Kabukicho  
Visit the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building for a view  
End the day with a bowl of ramen  

Day Two Exploring Old Edo  
Morning pilgrimage to Asakusa and Senso-ji Temple  
Walk Nakamise market where souvenirs doth call  
Afternoon cruise upon the Sumida River  
Evening admire the lights from Tokyo Tower  
Rest in thy lodging  

Day Three Journey to Kyoto  
Board the Shinkansen swift as wind  
Arrive in Kyoto where temples stand serene  
Visit Kinkaku-ji the Golden Pavilion  
Wander the Philosopher's Path lined with cherry  
Evening tea ceremony in a machiya house  

Day Four Nara and Osaka  
Morning train to Nara where deer doth roam  
Todai-ji houses the great Buddha  
Afternoon travel to Osaka the kitchen of Japan  
Dotonbori's neon signs doth beckon  
Taste takoyaki and okonomiyaki street fare  
Night return to Kyoto for rest  

Day Five Return to Tokyo  
Morning Shinkansen back to Edo's heart  
Final shopping in Akihabara electric town  
Visit the Mori Art Museum atop Roppongi Hills  
Farewell dinner of kaiseki cuisine  
Depart Narita with memories etched in soul
